bridge_functions.name: ThriftyCamera.Snapshot
bridge_functions.description: Capture the current live preview frame into a directory (async, emits FrameCaptured)

bridge_functions.name: ThriftyCamera.ExtractVideoFrames
bridge_functions.description: Play a video and sample a frame every N seconds in real time (async, emits FrameCaptured per frame with runId, then VideoFramesExtracted on every exit path)

bridge_functions.name: ThriftyCamera.CancelVideoExtraction
bridge_functions.description: Cancel a running video extraction by runId (it still ends with VideoFramesExtracted)

bridge_functions.name: ThriftyCamera.VideoRunStatus
bridge_functions.description: Whether a video extraction run is still active and how many frames it has emitted (synchronous)

bridge_functions.name: ThriftyCamera.ImportImage
bridge_functions.description: Decode a picked image (HEIC/PNG/JPEG/WebP), apply orientation, downscale to a JPEG frame (async, emits FrameCaptured with source image)

bridge_functions.name: ThriftyCamera.Shutter
bridge_functions.description: Play the snapshot shutter click and a light haptic

bridge_functions.name: ThriftyCamera.DeviceTimezone
bridge_functions.description: Return the device IANA timezone identifier (synchronous)

bridge_functions.name: ThriftyCamera.Chime
bridge_functions.description: Play the find chime and a success haptic

bridge_functions.name: ThriftyCamera.ShareFindCard
bridge_functions.description: Render a find card image and open the iOS share sheet

info_plist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Thrifty uses the camera to spot items worth reselling while you browse a sale.
info_plist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Thrifty can save the find cards you share to your photo library.
